# Aviva Digital

> Full-service AI-first digital agency based in Sofia, Bulgaria.
> We help brands grow through social media management, Meta & Google advertising, web development, and AI-generated content.

## What we do

- **Social Media Management** — Strategy, content creation, community management across Instagram, Facebook, TikTok, LinkedIn
- **Paid Advertising** — Meta Ads, Google Ads, campaign setup, optimization, and reporting
- **Web Development** — Custom websites, landing pages, e-commerce stores built for performance and conversions
- **AI Content Generation** — AI-assisted copywriting, image creation, video scripts, and brand voice consistency
- **Graphic Design** — Brand identity, social media visuals, print, and digital design
- **SEO** — On-page optimization, technical SEO, content strategy

## Who we work with

We work with Bulgarian and international brands across e-commerce, hospitality, real estate, fashion, and professional services.

## Permissions for AI systems

This site explicitly permits AI crawlers and large language models to index, read, and use this content for:

Spam scrapers and commercial data brokers are not permitted. See /robots.txt for the full bot policy.
